title: Framework Os Kernel Crate Consolidation
summary: W8c data-plane / OS-kernel consolidation: merge wasm-safe OS modules (store, spr←protocol rename, dsl, pack, infinite, flow, brep-related kernel pieces) into semio-framework-os-kernel at 💻️os/ Shape V2 owner root; keep guest SDK as semio-framework-plugin; defer host plane (db, workflow, neural, renderer, run) to follow-up. Wasm admission (cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 -p semio-framework-os-kernel) required before old-crate deletion. Registrar-handoff only for root Cargo.toml.
description: W8c (OS serial) slice 1 — kernel/data plane from spicy-umbrella plan Key merges → OS split.
